plugin.name: Yu Zhao · Cultivation Artifact
plugin.description:
## Yu Zhao · Cultivation Artifact

A spirit-sensitive jade artifact laid out as the eight trigrams around the taiji — the taiji core is the heart of Yu Zhao.

**All eight functions unlocked**

- **User Spaces**: the default space is the character's own ({{char}}); create more spaces, each with per-space Send-to-AI and AI-writable switches. Contacts, threads, notes, posts, orders and maps are editable in every space.
- **Life-bound Jade Tablet (Qian)**: name, gender, height, weight, appearance, garments, spiritual root, constitution, realm, status and hidden secrets, synced with the story every turn.
- **Messaging (Dui)**: one-on-one spirit talks and group chats with unread badges.
- **Jade Notes (Li)**: folders and sealed memos.
- **World Forum (Xun)**: cultivation-world posts and comments with echo counts.
- **Market (Zhen)**: goods listings, auction house and trade orders.
- **Pocket Space (Kan)**: spirit stones, coins and stored items.
- **World Map (Kun)**: current location and recent movement tracks.
- **Artifact Mgmt (Gen)**: local system page to seal/unseal functions to save tokens, with sync diagnosis, per-function data clearing and archive export/import.

**Notes**

- Protocol data is hidden from the story text automatically; tap the home sync row or the taiji core for the sync diagnosis page.
- Bagua badges surface sync alerts, unread messages and freshly synced sections; sealed slots show none.
- The floating jade entry is draggable; long-press it or reset it in Artifact Mgmt. It stays hidden outside chat pages.
- UI language follows the app locale; "Prompt language" chooses the language of the injected prompt; sync uses the diff format by default (only +/- changed rows are output), saving tokens.
settings.info: UI language follows the app. Seal unneeded slots in Artifact Mgmt to save usage; it also holds Space management (create/delete user spaces, per-space Send-to-AI and AI-writable switches), sync diagnosis, per-feature clearing and export/import. The chat sidebar opens Yu Zhao, restores a backup or clears all data (double-confirmed). The floating entry is draggable and hidden outside chats. "Prompt language" picks the story language; only recent data is sent, older content is archived for recall.

releaseNotes.3_0_0:
- Rework: the character/player dual-domain design is replaced by user spaces: a default space anchored to {{char}}, plus any number of user-created spaces, each holding a full independent data set.
- New: Space management with per-space Send-to-AI and AI-writable switches; protocol writes route by the space field of the turn row.
- New: contacts are free to add (custom names) and every space supports direct messaging, group posts and comments.
- Migration: legacy player data upgrades into a "Me" space; cross-domain mirror channels removed.
- Kept: two-tap delete with 6s undo, lorebook-authoritative storage, diff sync with budget control.
